about: Varroc Engineering Ltd was incorporated in 1988, is the flagship company of the Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar-based Varroc Group. Varroc is a global tier-1 automotive component group. It is engaged in the business of manufacturing and supplying automobile components to a wide range of OEMs across the globe [1]
